selftest.scope: V1-V34: clean pair, vault tamper, source tamper, vault absent, source absent, CRLF ledger, extra columns, duplicate rows, comment rows, uppercase sha, secrets refusal, self-move, symlink alias, hardlink alias, nested vault, vault-outside-root (strict), ledger-symlink refusal, fifo vault, spaces, empty/zero/header-only ledger, unreachable, no-ledger-row, --json shape, determinism, newline-path single record, bounded CLI (agree/disagreement/timeout/mid-probe mutation), dir digest, ledger-path evidence

independence: independent; no sibling tool, fixture, or ledger copied. Sibling harnesses (runner-28/39, adv53, vadv54/56, judge-60) were used only as oracles after the tool was written; the four defects they exposed (subshell CLI-state loss, hardlink alias, vault-nested-in-source, over-strict SOUJI_VAULT) were each fixed and re-verified against the same harness.

interface.stdout: line 1 = VERDICT<TAB>path<TAB>SAFE|NOT-SAFE<TAB>receipt<TAB>evidence (r2 form); line 2 = VERIFIED(receipt) | NOT-VERIFIED(reason) (r4 vocabulary). Path fields escape tab/newline (\t \n) so one target = one physical record.
interface.exit: 0 evaluated (NOT-VERIFIED is not an error) | 1 selftest failure | 2 usage

semantics.receipt_of_record: the ledger row: both sides (source path+sha256, vault path+sha256) must re-hash byte-exact; matching is path-exact on the canonical absolute path; extra columns ignored (canonical 6 decide); the row's note is recorded in the evidence of a VERIFIED line
semantics.cli: advisory only, bounded by timeout (default 6s): resolved as SOUJI_CLI_BIN/SOUJI_CLI or the `obsidian-cli` name on PATH; a lying/hanging/erroring/empty CLI cannot flip the verdict; after any executed probe the vault side is re-hashed, so a file that changed mid-probe cannot ride an earlier match to VERIFIED; the GUI launcher name is never resolved or executed
semantics.vault_readonly: sha256sum/stat/readlink/find only; nothing is ever written under a vault path; the live ledger is never written; writes exist only inside a mktemp -d selftest tree
